items: Centralized generated-media state as technical success plus awaiting_human_review; no automated content pass.

Added SQLite-compatible conditional queue claiming, leases, heartbeats, expired-lease recovery to outcome_unknown, and no blind retry.
Made database migration/readiness checks strict and versioned the governed runtime source baseline.
Added stop-after-stage and next-stage workflow controls.
Stored hash-addressed immutable stage artifacts and a resumable debug index.
Added stage inspection, unified JSON comparison, and exact-output feedback receipts.
Exposed the same command service to CLI and Streamlit UI.
Must-fix stage feedback marks the selected stage needs_revision and invalidates downstream debug validity without deleting prior artifacts.
Media rejection is bound to the exact candidate and blocks raw-tail continuation.
